title: CollapsePlugin
description: The ultimate plugin for Battle Royale
body:
# ⚔️ CollapsePlugin - Advanced Battle Royale Plugin

**The ultimate GUI-based Battle Royale plugin with team support, custom phases, and zero commands needed!**

Quick Royale delivers a complete Battle Royale experience for Minecraft servers with an innovative GUI-first approach. Everything from game management to recipe crafting is controlled through intuitive menus - no chat commands required for players!

## ✨ Core Features

### 🎮 **100% GUI Management**
- **Compass-based navigation** - Right-click your compass to access everything
- **Zero commands for players** - All interactions through beautiful menus
- **Admin panel** - Complete server control via GUI
- **Game browser** - Visual list of all active games with live status

### 🎯 **Dynamic Phase System**

**5 Customizable Game Phases:**
- **LOBBY** - Players gather and select teams
- **PREPARATION** - Pre-game setup and scenario selection
- **PVP** - Main combat phase begins
- **DEATHMATCH** - Final showdown in shrinking arena
- **END** - Victory celebration and statistics

**Per-Phase Rule Control:**
- Enable/disable PVP
- Allow/block player movement
- Block breaking and placing permissions
- Crafting access
- Potion brewing permissions
- Custom phase duration (in seconds)

### 👥 **Team System**

- **Configurable team count** - Set max teams in config
- **Team selection GUI** - Players choose teams before game starts
- **Custom team spawns** - Set spawn points per team (`/collapseadmin setspawn <teamId>`)
- **Team coordination** - Perfect for squad-based gameplay
- **Color-coded teams** - Easy visual identification

### 🎲 **Built-in Game Scenarios**

**UHCCore Mode:**
- Random spawn distribution
- Border shrinks from game start
- Configurable PVP delay timer (in minutes)
- Classic UHC-style gameplay

**Disable Nether Scenario:**
- Blocks Nether portal teleportation
- Keep players in the Overworld
- Perfect for focused PvP matches

**Expandable scenario system** - Easy to add more through `scenarios.yml`

### 🌍 **World Border Management**

- **Automatic shrinking** - Border closes in over time
- **Phase-based control** - Different border sizes per phase
- **UHCCore integration** - Starts shrinking immediately
- **Configurable speed** - Set how fast the border contracts
- **Damage zones** - Players take damage outside the border

### 🏠 **Lobby System**

- **Dedicated lobby spawn** - Set with `/collapseadmin setlobby`
- **Auto-teleport** - Players spawn in lobby on join
- **Game selection** - Browse and join available games
- **Status indicators** - See game states (waiting/active/ended) by color
- **Player counts** - Live display of players in each game

### 📜 **Custom Recipe System**

**Recipe Book Feature:**
- Every player receives a recipe book
- Right-click to view all custom crafts
- **Visual 3×3 crafting grid** - See exact recipe layouts
- **Admin controls** - Shift-click to enable/disable recipes

**GUI Recipe Editor:**
- "Add Recipe" button opens visual editor
- **Drag-and-drop crafting** - Place items in 3×3 grid
- Set result item and amount
- Save button creates and registers recipe instantly
- **Delete recipes** - Admins can remove recipes from preview menu
- No file editing required - all through GUI!

### 💀 **Golden Head Mechanic**

**Player Head Drops:**
- Player heads drop on death
- Craft into "Golden Heads"
- Customizable recipe via GUI

**Golden Head Effects (when eaten):**
- Speed I (10 seconds)
- Regeneration II (15 seconds)
- Absorption (golden hearts)
- Strategic healing item for intense battles

### 🎛️ **Game Management**

**Compass Menu (Players):**
- View game list
- See active scenarios
- Join available games
- Check game status

**Compass Menu (Admins):**
- Create new game
- Start/stop games
- Manage games list
- Configure scenarios
- View statistics
- Access settings panel

**Game Browser:**
- Color-coded status (waiting/preparation/active/ended)
- Live player counts
- Click to join games in waiting phase
- Real-time updates

### ⚙️ **Advanced Configuration**

**Config.yml settings:**
- Border configuration
- Team settings (max teams)
- Phase durations
- UHCCore parameters
- Game rules

**Scenarios.yml:**
- Scenario descriptions
- Enable/disable scenarios
- Custom scenario parameters

**Crafts.yml:**
- Stores custom recipes
- Auto-managed through GUI
- Backup of all recipes

### 🛠️ **Admin Commands**
```
/collapseadmin compass - Get admin compass
/collapseadmin setspawn <teamId> - Set team spawn point
/collapseadmin setlobby - Set lobby spawn location
```

### 📊 **Statistics & Tracking**

- Player statistics (coming soon - currently placeholder)
- Game history
- Per-scenario tracking
- Team performance metrics

## 🎯 **Perfect For**

- Team-based Battle Royale servers
- UHC-style competitive gameplay
- Mini-game networks with multiple arenas
- Event hosting with custom rules
- Tournament organization

## 🔧 **Technical Details**

- **Server Software:** Purpur 1.21 - 1.21.5
- **Java Version:** 21+
- **Lightweight:** Optimized performance
- **No dependencies required**
- **Localization ready:** Easy translation support

## 📦 **Quick Start**

1. Download and place in `plugins` folder
2. Restart server
3. Set lobby: `/collapseadmin setlobby`
4. Set team spawns: `/collapseadmin setspawn 1`, `/collapseadmin setspawn 2`, etc.
5. Players use compass to join games
6. Admins use compass to create and manage games
7. Customize scenarios and recipes through GUI!

## 🌟 **Why Choose Quick Royale?**

✅ **No command memorization** - Everything in GUI  
✅ **Team support** - Not just FFA  
✅ **Custom phases** - Design your perfect game flow  
✅ **Recipe editor** - Add custom items without coding  
✅ **Multiple games** - Run several matches simultaneously  
✅ **UHC mode** - Classic hardcore gameplay included  
✅ **Active development** - Regular updates and improvements  

*Transform your server into a professional Battle Royale arena!*
